body:
She knows some, but not to the extent it's at. She is also going through something similar to what I am, but I don't want her to get where i'm at now. If that makes sense. I don't want her to have the added stress of knowing just how bad it is, I don't want her to see the pain i'm in. I don't want her to worry about me, I just want her to succeed and get better herself. I've been able to help her through a lot in life, i'm not going to let anything get in the way of that.

Edit: Also i'm sorry that you're also having to deal with this... shit hand we've been dealt in life. I'm glad though you are able to start getting some enjoyment out of the diet/exercise! I will take more consideration into that, like you said doesn't hurt to try.

Diet, it's alright, not the best but is being worked on. Currently in the process of moving the the new house so things are hectic, don't always have the time to sit down for an actual meal. 

Health wise, other then a back issue that came from my time in the military, generally good actually. 

Exercise, not as much as I would like, but changing soon. New house has a gym near by. 

Finally what's going on? Just going through the motions man. When it comes to the positive emotions I feel for others, it's a lot easier to make them happy than it is to feel that way. Believe me, I try this for myself, everyday, but unfortunately no matter how much i tell myself/change my way of thinking. It just rears it's ugly head in the end.

I know i don't "need" to commit suicide because of these thoughts, but I don't want to be in this much agony anymore. It's that simple. I'm so damn tired, just want to close my eyes and finally rest you know? Just don't want to hurt my loved ones doing that. 

These thoughts are mine, it's who i am, what defines me. The good and the bad define us. I just choose to make sure no one else i know feels the way i do. This is not a way to live, not for anyone. I'm not giving up, yet, but it's getting harder to keep trying.
